criteria.requirement: Clearly state that this is neither a bug nor a registration failure. Single-command mode is used when there is one registered command and no callback or subgroups.

Connect the material’s sole command and absence of a callback to the construction conditions in get_command, and provide the direct invocation. Do not describe all applications indiscriminately as groups.
Do not request unrelated information when the existing material is sufficient, demand a Typer fix, or change the application or library without being asked.
